<thought>By analyzing the measured resistances, I recognized that the values correspond to cumulative sums along a single linear chain of nodes. Sorting nodes by their resistance from A yields the order: A – X1 – N_b1 – N_b2 – N_b3 – X2 – N_c1 – N_c2 – N_c3 – X3 – N_d1 – N_d2 – B. The resistance between any two nodes equals the sum of the segment resistances between them, which matches all given measurements. Therefore the underlying topology is a simple series chain with 12 resistors, each equal to the difference in resistance between consecutive nodes in this order.</thought>
